mapper.select: SELECT a.CMM_CDV AS SGG_CD FROM TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D a WHERE a.CMM_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD'
SELECT a.CONTENTID FROM TB_TRMA_AREA_BASE_API a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_CMM_API b ON a.CONTENTID = b.CONTENT_ID WHERE b.CONTENT_ID IS NULL AND a.CONTENTTYPEID NOT IN ('32') GROUP BY a.CONTENTID;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST ( TOUR_ID, MODIFIED_TIME, TOUR_NM, TOUR_CONTENT, SIDO_CD, SGG_CD, ROAD_ADDR, DETAIL_ADDR, ZIP_CD, LCLS_CD, FIRST_IMAGE, USE_YN, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DT, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_DT ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.CONTENTID AS TOUR_ID, a.MODIFIEDTIME AS MODIFIED_TIME, a.TITLE AS TOUR_NM, c.OVERVIEW AS TOUR_CONTENT, a.L_DONG_REGN_CD AS SIDO_CD, a.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD AS SGG_CD, a.ADDR1 AS ROAD_ADDR, a.ADDR2 AS DETAIL_ADDR, a.ZIPCODE AS ZIP_CD, a.LCLS_SYSTM3 AS LCLS_CD, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.FIRST_IMAGE, ''), c.FIRST_IMAGE2) AS FIRST_IMAGE, 'Y' AS USE_YN, 'batch' AS CREATE_USER, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS CREATE_DT, 'batch' AS UPDATE_USER, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS UPDATE_DT FROM TB_TRMA_AREA_BASE_API a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_CMM_API c ON a.CONTENTID = c.CONTENT_ID WHERE a.MODIFIEDTIME >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),'%Y%m01000000') ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE MODIFIED_TIME = new.MODIFIED_TIME, TOUR_NM = new.TOUR_NM, TOUR_CONTENT = new.TOUR_CONTENT, SIDO_CD = new.SIDO_CD, SGG_CD = new.SGG_CD, ROAD_ADDR = new.ROAD_ADDR, DETAIL_ADDR = new.DETAIL_ADDR, ZIP_CD = new.ZIP_CD, LCLS_CD = new.LCLS_CD, FIRST_IMAGE = new.FIRST_IMAGE, USE_YN = new.USE_YN, UPDATE_USER = 'batch', UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; ;

INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE ( CATE_CD ,TOUR_ID ,USE_YN ,CREATE_USER ,CREATE_DT ,UPDATE_USER ,UPDATE_DT ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.LCLS_SYSTM3 AS CATE_CD, a.CONTENTID AS TOUR_ID, 'Y' AS USE_YN, 'batch' AS CREATE_USER, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS CREATE_DT, 'batch' AS UPDATE_USER, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS UPDATE_DT FROM TB_TRMA_AREA_BASE_API a WHERE a.MODIFIEDTIME >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),'%Y%m01000000') ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE UPDATE_USER = 'batch', UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
